svg.title: The method around the model
svg.desc: Timeline. 2006: Processbench, machine learning prices a part from its value drivers. 2018 and 2021: VDI 2817, the method becomes a German standard. Now: SupplyConnect, language models in a harness of prompts, gates and checks. Next: flow efficiency, research, online soon.
